query:
SELECT 'dashboard_items' as table_name, COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_bold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_items
FROM dashboard_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 'software_items', COUNT(*), 
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM software_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 'systems_items', COUNT(*), 
  SUM(CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%**%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_new = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM systems_items;
